title: Pitcairn Islands Marine Protected Area Ordinance 2016 (Ordinance No. 3 of 2016, Cap. 48)
citation: Pitcairn Islands Marine Protected Area Ordinance 2016 (No. 3 of 2016), Revised Edition of the Laws 2017, Cap. 48; commencement Order of 14 September 2016 printed in the chapter
evidence: Order printed on p. 857 of Cap. 48 (PDF opened 2026-11-10): "I order that the Pitcairn Islands Marine Protected Area Ordinance 2016 be brought into force on Thursday 15 September 2016 (Pitcairn Standard Time), except as provided by section 2(2) of that Ordinance." Made at Wellington on 14 September 2016 (NZST) by Governor Jonathan Sinclair. Section 2(2): "Section 10 comes into force on a date appointed by the Governor by Order following the passing of Marine Conservation Regulations."
notes: Marine conservation law: establishes the Pitcairn Islands Marine Protected Area, prohibits and regulates activities in it (fishing, discharge, dumping), and sets offences; narrower than a general environmental framework and not a climate law. The brief's note that no commencement Order was found is corrected: the Order is printed in the chapter. Section 10 (regulated activities) waits for a second Order; none is on the laws page. Date is the Pitcairn-time date in the Order; 14 September 2016 in NZST. Not stored: PN-GOVPN-CONSOLIDATED is permission requested (reuse unstated, "© Copyright MMXXIII Pitcairn Islands Office"). English only; no official language is stated on any government page and no translation exists to look for (the site publishes English only).
